_comment: Shared crypto golden vectors. This is the ONLY committed copy: Dart reads it directly (test/crypto_vectors_test.dart), Swift walks up to it from #filePath (native/ios CryptoVectorsTests), and the Android instrumented suite gets a build-time copy staged into its test assets by the copyCryptoVectors gradle task. ALL THREE must verify these; a divergence on any platform is a crypto-mirror drift bug, not a test bug. Wire format is base64(nonce || ciphertext), nonce 24B, MAC 16B. box_decrypt pins X25519 DH (deriveSharedSecret) + crypto_box open; seal_open pins crypto_box_seal_open incl. tamper/wrong-recipient -> null; secretbox_decrypt pins crypto_secretbox open (the symmetric backup/blob format) incl. tamper/wrong-key -> failure. expectFail cases fail as null on the native mirrors and as SodiumException in Dart.

box_decrypt.desc: box decrypt of an alert payload (title/body/group_id)
box decrypt with unicode + nested values

seal_open.desc: sealed box opens to the display name with the recipient keypair
a tampered sealed box must NOT open (auth tag rejects)
wrong recipient keypair cannot open the sealed box

secretbox_decrypt.desc: secretbox decrypt keyed with deriveBackupKey(seed 0x00..0x1f, domain 'identity-pad-v1') — the key doubles as that derivation's known answer, so this pins the derive -> encrypt -> decrypt backup pipeline
secretbox decrypt with a unicode payload
a tampered secretbox must NOT open (auth tag rejects)
the wrong key must NOT open (key is the identity-spec-backup-v1 known answer)
